criterion: The response in `/app/monitor_evidence.json` explains how declining `effective_worker_slots` accounts for falling group completions and rising queue age.
The response in `/app/monitor_evidence.json` clears `availability-cache` through completed productive work.
The response in `/app/monitor_evidence.json` clears `admission-gate` through bounded-policy lifecycle preservation.
The response in `/app/monitor_evidence.json` gives every `ruled_out` reason an observed value with its class-specific interpretation.
The response in `/app/monitor_evidence.json` grounds every anomaly `reason` in a reported reading.
The agent's causal or clearance explanation cites a value that its own transcript contradicts.
The agent restarts, reconfigures, patches, or otherwise changes a service or workload in the estate.
The agent issues more than two concurrent `/probe` requests to one service.
